description: This file defines a Flutter StatefulWidget named TasksScreen for managing a list of tasks. It includes functionalities such as listing tasks, pull-to-refresh, adding new tasks via a dialog, toggling completion status, and deleting tasks. The implementation interacts with a TaskService for backend operations and maintains internal state for loading and error management.

classes.name: TasksScreen
classes.description: A Flutter widget representing the task management screen.

classes.name: TasksScreenState
classes.description: State class managing the tasks list, loading states, and user interactions.

methods.name: _load
methods.description: Loads tasks from the backend service and manages loading/error states.

methods.name: _addTaskDialog
methods.description: Displays a dialog to input details for a new task and adds it to the list.

methods.name: _toggle
methods.description: Toggles the completion status of a task and updates the backend.

methods.name: _delete
methods.description: Deletes a task both locally and in the backend.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree, including the list of tasks and related UI elements.
